pricing.title: Clear prices, agreed before we start
pricing.lead: You get the scope and the price in writing before you pay. Everything is one-off — no subscription, no automatic renewal.
pricing.vat: Prices in NOK. Pilot pricing, subject to change.
pricing.later: More services follow when someone asks for them. We start narrow so you know exactly what you are buying.

safety.title: Rules we never break
safety.lead: We promise clarity — not a particular outcome in your case. You trust us with sensitive matters, and these rules are not negotiable.
rules: We never ask for your BankID password or codes.
We never log in to your accounts using your identity.
We work with you present, or under a written authorisation you have given.
Sensitive documents are never sent by ordinary email.
We never guarantee an outcome or a benefit.
Cases requiring legal representation are referred to a lawyer.

booking.title: Start with a free scope check
booking.lead: Tell us briefly what you need. We answer within one working day with a yes or a no — and with the scope and price if we can help.
booking.noSlots: No available times on this day. Please choose another day.
booking.name: Full name
booking.casePlaceholder: What you need practical help with. Do not write national ID numbers, health information or the contents of a decision.
booking.noSensitive: Please do not write national identity numbers or health information in this field. You will get a secure channel for documents after booking.
booking.consent: I agree that NAVIAR may contact me about this case and use my details only for that.
booking.payFree: This meeting is free. No payment is needed.
booking.doneLead: We have your request. Keep the reference.
booking.doneNext: We answer by email within one working day. If we can help, you get the scope, the price and the terms in writing before you pay. Never send sensitive documents by ordinary email.

booking.errGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again, or contact us directly.
booking.errSlotTaken: That time was just taken. Please choose another.
booking.expressD: If an available advisor accepts, your case is prioritised.
booking.angrerett: Services bought online carry a 14-day right of withdrawal. If you want us to start before that period is over, we ask for your explicit consent in the offer. You then accept that the right of withdrawal ends once the service has been delivered in full.
booking.deliveryNote: No meeting is needed for this service. We deliver in writing within {sla}.
booking.uploadNote: Describe the case in your own words. You do not need to upload the document or give sensitive details now.
booking.tolkNotice: A public body assesses the need for an interpreter in its own meetings and orders a qualified one. Private language support is only for the conversations you have yourself.
booking.fitFirst: We check that the case fits before you pay.
booking.returnPaid: Thank you. The payment went through and your case is registered.
booking.returnCancelled: The payment was cancelled, so nothing has been charged. Your case is saved — get in touch if you want to complete it.
booking.riskLead: If your request involves anything on this list, we cannot take it. We will point you to the right body instead.
riskItems: Interpreting a decision, refusal, appeal or legal deadline
Judging your rights or the outcome of a case

Health records, national ID numbers or other sensitive documents

booking.riskConfirm: I confirm that my request is for practical help only, and for nothing on the list above.
booking.noPayNow: You pay nothing now. If we can help, we send the scope, the price and the terms in writing — and only then a payment link.
booking.goal: What do you want to achieve?
booking.goalPlaceholder: For example: I want to change industry, or I get no reply to my applications. Do not write national ID numbers or health information.
booking.noDocs: Do not send a CV or any other document here. If we need your CV for a personal review, you get a separate secure link afterwards.
booking.phoneOptional: Optional. We only need your name, email, language and what you want to achieve.

items.a: No. NAVIAR is an independent company and is not part of NAV or any public authority. We work for you, not for the office handling your case.

items.q: Can you guarantee that I get the benefit or the permit?
items.a: No, and you should not trust anyone who says they can. We do not judge rights and we do not predict outcomes. What we do is practical: find the right channel, write out the questions, and make a checklist.

Never your password or codes. Either you are present and log in yourself, or you give us a written authorisation (fullmakt) that defines exactly what we may do and for how long. You can withdraw it at any time.
The scope check is free. A practical guide costs 590 kr and job application support costs 790 kr. Private language support is by quote. You get the scope and the price in writing before you pay.

items.q: Which languages can I get help in?
items.a: We work in Norwegian, English, Turkish, Arabic, Polish, Ukrainian, Russian and Somali. Tell us your preferred language when you book.
No. We give practical guidance, not legal advice. If your matter concerns a decision, an appeal, a deadline, health, tax, debt or residency, we refer you to the right body or to a lawyer.

items.q: How do I send documents safely?
items.a: You should not send documents at all. Describe what you need in your own words. We never ask for health records, national ID numbers or other sensitive documents.
